description: This file defines the interface for the 'Library' class within the Thunder::Core namespace, including its data members, constructors, methods, and internal structures related to dynamic library handling.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: A class managing dynamic library loading, unloading, and symbol resolution, with reference counting and platform-specific handle management.

methods.name: Library
methods.description: Default constructor for the Library class.

methods.name: Library(const void* functionInLibrary)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the library object with a function pointer from the library.

methods.name: Library(const TCHAR fileName[])
methods.description: Constructor that loads a library from a specified filename.

methods.name: Library(Library&& move)
methods.description: Move constructor for the Library class.

methods.name: Library(const Library& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor for the Library class.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying a Library object.

methods.name: operator=(Library&& move)
methods.description: Move assignment operator for the Library class.

methods.name: IsLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the library is currently loaded.

methods.name: WaitUnloaded
methods.description: Waits for the library to unload within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the last error message related to library operations.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the loaded library.

methods.name: LoadFunction
methods.description: Loads a function from the library by name.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the library handle.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and potentially unloads the library.
